name: tests-only-folio-encrypted-pdf-credential-rotation-and-9c73
instr:
Implement this while preserving existing unencrypted workflows.

The `github.com/carlos7ags/folio/core` profile API comprises `EncryptionRevision`, `EncryptionProfile`, `DecodeEncryptionProfile`, `EncryptionProfile.BuildDictionary`, `RotationStage`, and `RotationError`. It must losslessly round-trip RC4-128, AES-128, and AES-256 dictionaries without mutation or aliasing. Validate revision-specific lengths, crypt filters, field representations, and authentication data before authentication succeeds or output begins. Preserve existing wrong-password and unsupported-encryption errors, and identify the failure stage, object, or field.

Rewrite the complete reachable graph under the destination policy, excluding unreachable objects. Preserve meaning, generations, shared references, compressed members, payloads, and metadata semantics. Use final emitted coordinates for encryption. Traditional and stream cross-references must address every emitted object and the replacement encryption dictionary. Shared compressed and uncompressed objects retain one identity and receive exactly one successful payload transformation. Nonzero-generation output must reopen only with the replacement credentials.

Authentication, cancellation, malformed or corrupt reachable objects, inventory failures, contradictory profiles, and wrong credentials must produce compatible staged failures without writing destination bytes.
